guidetextdraw._value: The Golden State Teacher Grant (GSTG) is state funding offered by the California Student Aid Commission (CSAC) for students enrolled in a credential program. The online GSTG CSAC application deadline is March 31, 2023 and must be submitted if you’re a new applicant for this program.Submit this form annually to have your GSTG eligibility reviewed by our campus.
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1667548879996

guidetextdraw_200761826._value: GSTG program can pay up to $20,000, distributed throughout multiple academic years; however, you must complete the credential program within three years from the date the first payment is disbursed to you. Please review CSAC’s website for additional information,and our Financial Aid website for the application process.
guidetextdraw_200761826.name: textdraw_2007618261667548904157

guidetextdraw._value:
The GSTG amount is determined based on your estimated Cost of Attendance (COA), minus other Financial Aid awarded.

  • COA includes tuition and fees, room and board, books and supplies, transportation,and miscellaneous expenses. 
  • To maximize the amount of GSTG this academic year, you have the option to request a reduction or cancellation of student loan(s) you may have accepted or received. This means that GSTG funds will replace the loans, essentially paying off a portion or the entirety of your loans for the Academic Year or semester.  
  • Review our Financial Aid website for more information on how Middle Class Scholarship is affected by GSTG and how the Federal TEACH grant impacts eligibility for the GSTG funds.

In the example shown here, a student can receive $17,113 in GSTG for Fall and Spring terms, but if student requests a loan reduction, the GSTG funds can be increased to $20,000. If loans are not canceled, remaining  GSTG can be awarded the following year, if continued enrollment in an eligible program.
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1667551449793

The GSTG amount is determined based on your estimated Cost of Attendance (COA), minus other Financial Aid awarded.

  • COA includes tuition and fees, room and board, books and supplies, transportation,and miscellaneous expenses. 
  • To maximize the amount of GSTG this academic year, you have the option to request a reduction or cancellation of student loan(s) you may have accepted or received. This means that GSTG funds will replace the loans, essentially paying off a portion or the entirety of your loans for the Academic Year or semester.  
  • Review our Financial Aid website for more information on how Middle Class Scholarship is affected by GSTG and how the Federal TEACH grant impacts eligibility for the GSTG funds.

In the example shown here, a student can receive $8,644 in GSTG for one semester, but if student requests a loan reduction, the GSTG funds can be increased to $10,000 - keep in mind award sizes vary, depending on your application cohort. Any remaining GSTG funds not used for this aid year, may be used for the following aid year, and is dependent upon program eligibility, and availability of funds.

guidetextdraw_1530201539._value: Select ONE of the statements to indicate what action you would like to be taken with your loan(s):
guidetextdraw_1530201539.name: textdraw_15302015391667553491873

guidetextdraw_copy._value: I have not accepted or have applied for student loans. Please certify Golden State Teacher Grant up to my maximum eligibility across my term(s) of enrollment, minus any other applicable grants/scholarships.
guidetextdraw_copy.name: textdraw1667553993830

guidetextdraw_copy_c._value: Cancel or reduce my student loan(s) as needed to maximize the amount I can receive for GSTG across my term(s) of enrollment. I understand that if the loan already disbursed to me or towards my tuition, the reduction/cancelation will create a charge on my account, which will be covered by GSTG funds, either by me (after getting the refund) or automatically once GSTG pays. The adjustments will take place once the Financial Aid Office receives the GSTG funds.
guidetextdraw_copy_c.name: textdraw1667553993830_copy_1

guidetextdraw_copy_3._value: Do not Cancel or Reduce my student loan(s). Certify Golden State Teacher Grant up to my remaining eligibility across my term(s) of enrollment. I understand this may limit the GSTG amount I will get for this academic year or term.
guidetextdraw_copy_3.name: textdraw1667553993830_copy_2

guidetextdraw_419589689._value: Please Note: Regardless of what option you select above, if the $20,000 funds are NOT exhausted this academic year, CSAC will renew your application for next aid year, and you will be awarded after our campus verifies all eligibility requirements.
guidetextdraw_419589689.name: textdraw_4195896891667558170800
